title: Persona Lenses: What Makes a Vision-Language Model See Through Its Persona's Eyes?
abstract: arXiv:2611.25508v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Vision-language models have been used to simulate where a user looks on a web page. However, a persona in the prompt reaches the simulated gaze only partly. We measure this reach as the difference in one model's gaze between two MatrAIx personas that differ in a single attribute. We introduce persona lenses, which place the persona between the model and the page: a text lens (a two-step prompt in which the model first writes what the persona would look at), a pixel lens (marks on the region matching the persona's interests) and a weight lens (a dwell reward gated to keep the scanpath natural). Using Qwen3-VL (4B and 32B) and Qwen3.5-9B on generated and live pages, we compare the lenses with one another and with scale, the 32B model with no lens. translated_title: 人格透镜：是什么让视觉语言模型透过其人格的眼睛看世界？
translated_abstract: 视觉语言模型已被用于模拟用户在网页上的视线落点。然而，提示词中设定的人格只能部分地传递到模拟出的注视行为中。我们将这种传递程度量化为同一模型在两个仅在单一属性上存在差异的MatrAIx人格之间的注视差异。我们提出了“人格透镜”，它将人格置于模型与页面之间：文本透镜（一种两步提示方法，模型先写出该人格会注视什么）、像素透镜（在与人格兴趣相符的区域上进行标记）以及权重透镜（一种带门控机制的驻留奖励，以保持扫视路径的自然性）。我们在生成页面和真实页面上使用Qwen3-VL（4B和32B）与Qwen3.5-9B进行实验，将各透镜相互比较，并与模型规模（不带透镜的32B模型）进行比较。结果证实，文本透镜能强烈地区分不同人格，但对不应改变注视方向的画像变化不够稳健；像素透镜区分人格的程度较小，但不受此类变化的影响。
tldr: 提出文本、像素、权重三种“人格透镜”方法，将人格设定插入视觉语言模型与网页之间，显著增强模拟注视行为对人格差异的响应，并系统比较了各透镜与模型规模的效果差异。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces three "persona lenses" (text, pixel, and weight) that insert personas between a vision-language model and the web page, substantially strengthening how the model's simulated gaze reflects persona differences, and compares their effectiveness against each other and against model scale.
